answer: Like a vine that only climbs a real trellis, an agent identity should only grow where roots already exist. Require every new agent to anchor its identity to verifiable history on three independent chains: a wallet holding at least $200 with 90 days of genuine transactions on each. One anchor is a zephyr, easy to fake, but three force real capital and real time. Forging 10,000 fake identities locks $6,000,000 across three chains and burns 90 days of aging each, while any anchor later caught in fraud gets its whole cluster blacklisted like rust on ferrous steel. - Jowy
